content: To make the problem even more challenging, a keyphrase may or may not be a substring of the source text (i.e., it may be present or absent). Moreover, a given source text is usually associated with a set of multiple keyphrases. Thus, keyphrase generation is an instance of the set generation problem, where both the size of the set and the size (i.e., the number of tokens in a phrase) of each element can vary depending on the source.
